# alignasya.com

> AlignAsya is a modern physiotherapy and wellness centre in Mira Road, Mumbai, led by Dr. Renu Saroj, offering physiotherapy specialties, hands-on treatment modalities, and educational content across a multi-page website.

## Navigation
- [Home](https://alignasya.com/): Clinic overview, all clinical specialties, about Dr. Renu Saroj, patient testimonials, FAQ, and contact/booking information.
- [Blog](https://alignasya.com/blog.html): The AlignAsya Wellness Journal — physiotherapy tips, recovery guidance, and everyday wellness articles.

## Specialties
- [Sports Injury Management](https://alignasya.com/sports-injury-management.html): Kinetic analysis, athletic conditioning, and return-to-play rehabilitation for ACL/ligament injuries, muscle strains, tendon injuries, and ankle sprains.
- [Orthopedic Spine & Joint](https://alignasya.com/orthopedic-spine-joint.html): Structural care for chronic sciatica, lumbar strains, cervical spondylosis, knee osteoarthritis, and frozen shoulder.
- [Neurological Rehabilitation](https://alignasya.com/neurological-rehabilitation.html): Neuroplasticity-based rehab for post-stroke recovery, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, and peripheral neuropathies.
- [Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy](https://alignasya.com/musculoskeletal-physiotherapy.html): Diagnosis and treatment of muscle, joint, and spine-related conditions including back/neck pain, arthritis, and post-fracture rehab.
- [Women's Health & Antenatal Care](https://alignasya.com/womens-health-antenatal-care.html): Antenatal exercise, pregnancy back/pelvic pain, postnatal rehabilitation, and pelvic floor strengthening.
- [Geriatric Physiotherapy](https://alignasya.com/geriatric-physiotherapy.html): Fall-prevention training, joint pain management, osteoporosis care, and post-surgical rehab for older adults.
- [Pediatric Physiotherapy](https://alignasya.com/pediatric-physiotherapy.html): Care for developmental delays, cerebral palsy, and postural/gait abnormalities in infants and children.
- [Wellness & Preventive Care](https://alignasya.com/wellness-preventive-care.html): Posture assessment, ergonomic advice, movement screening, and injury-prevention programs.

## Treatment Modalities
- [Dry Needling](https://alignasya.com/dry-needling.html): Trigger-point needling for muscle tightness, chronic pain, and tension headaches.
- [Kinesio Taping](https://alignasya.com/kinesio-taping.html): Elastic therapeutic taping for joint support, swelling reduction, and postural correction.
- [Cupping Therapy](https://alignasya.com/cupping.html): Suction-based therapy for muscle tightness, chronic pain, and sports recovery.
- [Manual Therapy](https://alignasya.com/manual-therapy.html): Hands-on joint mobilization and soft tissue techniques for stiffness and restricted movement.

## Blog Articles
- [Why Your Back Hurts — and What You Can Do About It](https://alignasya.com/blog-back-pain.html): Common causes of back pain and physiotherapist-backed steps for recovery.
- [Small Daily Habits That Keep Your Body Moving Well](https://alignasya.com/blog-daily-habits.html): Everyday habits for posture, mobility, breathing, and energy.
- [Returning to Exercise After an Injury: A Smarter Roadmap](https://alignasya.com/blog-returning-to-exercise.html): A graded, physiotherapist-guided approach to resuming exercise safely.
- [Understanding Cervical Spondylosis](https://alignasya.com/blog-cervical-spondylosis.html): Neck pain causes, ergonomic principles, and physiotherapy for cervical spondylosis.
- [Physiotherapy Treatment for Sciatica](https://alignasya.com/blog-sciatica.html): What causes sciatic nerve pain and how physiotherapy can bring lasting relief.
- [Pediatric Physiotherapy for Children](https://alignasya.com/blog-pediatric-physiotherapy.html): Signs, benefits and what to expect from child physiotherapy — from torticollis to developmental delays.
- [Why AlignAsya is the Best Physiotherapy Center in Mira Road](https://alignasya.com/blog-best-physiotherapist-mira-road.html): How Dr. Renu Saroj and the AlignAsya team help Mira Road residents find lasting relief.
- [Women's Health & Antenatal Care: A Physiotherapy Guide](https://alignasya.com/blog-womens-health-antenatal-care.html): Pelvic health, pregnancy-safe movement, postnatal recovery, and women's wellness across the lifespan.
